 We are hiring a Distinguished Data Scientist to lead the design and development of Walmart Connect's next\-generation ads incrementality measurement platform. We are looking for a scientist with rare depth in causal inference, incrementality and RCT experimentation who thrives on doing the hard technical work, not just directing it. You will own the methodology end\-to\-end, partner with engineering and product to carry solutions into production, and serve as the team's go\-to authority on the hardest measurement problems. You will help set the bar for what rigorous, causally grounded ads measurement looks like at Walmart Connect.
   

  

 About the team:
   

  

 The team advances advertising measurement by applying innovative data science and machine learning techniques. It focuses on causal inference and incrementality experimentation to deliver actionable insights.
   

  

 What you'll do:
   

  

* Design and implement large\-scale causal inference methodologies to measure the true incremental lift of advertising across campaigns, channels, and segments
* Establish evaluation frameworks, exit criteria, and solution readiness standards causal inference methodologies, grounding approach in hypotheses and data validations
* Author high\-quality technical design documents and whitepapers; present to senior leadership
* Define the science roadmap for incrementality and causal measurement; prioritize the highest\-leverage problems and make principled trade\-offs
* Develop event\-grain incrementality models (Uplift DNN) to power ads bidding optimization
* Partner with engineers to design data pipelines and schema that meet the precision requirements of causal measurement at scale
* Mentor senior/mid\-level scientists; Develop technical vision \& strategy


 What you'll bring:
   

  

* PhD or Master's in Statistics, Economics, Econometrics, Computer Science, or a related quantitative field — PhD strongly preferred
* 8\+ years in data science or quantitative research , ads industry experience preferred
* Deep, specialized expertise in causal inference and/or incrementality\-based optimization — Randomized control trials, PIE model, instrumental variables, uplift DNN, regression discontinuity and related methods
* Strong command of experiment design at scale — power analysis, variance reduction, interference and spillover handling, and bias correction
* Proficiency in Python and SQL for large\-scale data analysis and experience with distributed data platforms (Spark, BigQuery, or equivalent)
* Strong statistical foundations and machine learning knowledge
